title: His wife's piano style and solos
summary: Her piano style and whether pianists took solos in those days.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom

blocks.x: Is there anything else you can think of about your wife? I don't like to keep bothering you about... Oh, that's all right. ...since she isn't here, if there's anything else you could add about her life and the style of piano that she played.
Well, she played both kinds, she was wonderful. She played a lot of solo.
She was side-wheeling, then she could change keys, yeah.
She was wonderful. All them bands, she'd play, so come get all of them.
In those days, did the pianist ever take many solos?
They do it, no, take hops.
Of course, nowadays, they take a solo, everybody takes a solo after that.
Yeah, she was wonderful on that. I just wondered if they did in those days. Yeah, all the same way they take... Played mostly chords and...
